note: Rendered on /burnticker/operator and served by GET /api/burnticker/v1/operator (src/lib/burnticker/trustpack/operator.ts). Every value that starts with TODO_ is a placeholder the owner fills in; docs/burnticker/TODO-OWNER.md lists each one with its file and line, and the page says each one in words. Devnet public keys are copied from the rehearsal records named in each `source` (test/burntickerTrustPack.test.ts checks every one appears there). Mainnet rows carry the addresses the owner configured on 2026-10-11 (the keeper key is the attester in the mainnet rehearsal evidence; the deployer key ran the mainnet deploy); nothing here is a secret.

signedMessage.how: Once the operator signs the statement and the signature is added here, the site checks it with ed25519 and shows the result and the time of the check. The signing steps are in docs/burnticker/runbook.md, under Signing the operator statement.

neverBuys.rule: None of the wallets above ever acquires a coin launched through the platform. The monitor lists every token account those wallets hold, and every recent transaction that gave one of them a platform coin.
neverBuys.rehearsalNote: On devnet, the rehearsal itself traded on the curves. The keeper and the payer bought and sold test coins to prove that fees go where they should and that selling back works. Those trades are listed as explained, each with the evidence file that records it. On mainnet, any acquisition turns the status line red.
